# Billing Model

## Purpose
The Billing Model module defines entities for financial transactions, invoicing, and payment management within the system.

## Key Entities
- **Invoice**: Represents a request for payment.
- **Charge**: Represents a specific amount to be paid.
- **Payment**: Records a payment transaction.
- **PaymentMethod**: Defines how a user pays (e.g., Credit Card).
- **Receipt**: Proof of payment.

## Class Diagram
```mermaid
classDiagram
    Baseclass <|-- Invoice
    Baseclass <|-- InvoiceItem
    Baseclass <|-- Payment
    Baseclass <|-- Receipt
    Baseclass <|-- Charge
    Baseclass <|-- ChargeReference
    Baseclass <|-- PaymentMethod

    Invoice "1" *-- "many" InvoiceItem
    Invoice "many" -- "1" Receipt
    Payment "1" -- "many" Receipt
    Payment "many" -- "1" PaymentMethod
    Charge "many" -- "1" InvoiceItem
    Charge "1" -- "many" ChargeReference

    class Invoice {
        +OffsetDateTime invoiceDate
        +String invoiceReference
        +Receipt receipt
    }
    class InvoiceItem {
        +Invoice invoice
    }
    class Payment {
        +OffsetDateTime datePaid
        +String paymentReference
        +Money money
    }
    class Receipt {
        +Payment payment
    }
    class Charge {
        +String chargeReference
    }
```
